# baseline: no block read
LOAD 3 0 ticks=1 loaded=true
UNLOAD 3 0 ticks=1 loaded=false
# a block read of chunk 3 adds a ticket
LOAD 3 0 ticks=1 loaded=true
CF msg Changed the block at 56, -61, 0
CF result success 1
UNLOAD 3 0 ticks=2 loaded=false
# the game event of the block destroyed in chunk 2 reaches chunk 3 first
LOAD 3 0 ticks=1 loaded=true
CF msg Changed the block at 40, -61, 0
CF result success 1
DESTROY true
CF msg Changed the block at 56, -61, 0
CF result success 1
UNLOAD 3 0 ticks=1 loaded=false
